subject: Request: identity-controls evidence for SIG/CAIQ review
messages:
From: Elena Morales <security@medixcorp.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: identity-controls evidence for SIG/CAIQ review

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for taking this. As part of Medix Health's SIG/CAIQ review ahead of our procurement committee (deadline: 2026-07-26), we need a short bundle of identity and access control evidence to validate SSO/provisioning and least-privilege controls. Can you provide the following by next Monday (7/26)? If you have a day earlier that works, even better.

Requested artifacts and clarifications:
- SAML metadata XML and a sample SAML Response (with attributes redacted)
- SCIM schema/export showing supported attributes and group provisioning behavior (including whether groups are scoped and how membership is represented)
- Recent SCIM provisioning event sample (log snippet) demonstrating create/update/deprovision events
- RBAC matrix CSV mapping roles to permissions and the default admin roles
- A signed least-privilege attestation (who approves admin assignments, periodic review cadence)
- Confirmation of whether SCIM enforces required attributes for accounts created via provisioning
- Description of how service accounts / API keys are provisioned and rotated (policy or link is fine)

If you prefer a secure share or an SSO-enabled Drive link for artifacts, we can accept that. Also let me know if you need a nondisclosure / DPA in place to share logs.

Appreciate your help — this is the last open item for our security review.

Best,
Elena Morales
Senior InfoSec Manager
Medix Health

Elena — thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble a proof pack and aim to get the bulk of artifacts to you by Wednesday 7/21.

Plan: Laura will export the SCIM schema and RBAC matrix; Rishi will compile provisioning logs and the attestation. We'll put everything in a secure Drive folder and share the link with access limited to your security distribution list. If you need a signed PDF attestation, we'll have Monica Patel (Security Manager) sign it.

Attached is a short checklist so we all have the same scope. If anything in your list is mandatory vs optional, call it out and we'll prioritize.

Thanks,
Rachel
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 11:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: identity-controls evidence for SIG/CAIQ review

Looping in details from the engineering/ops side — I can produce the following artifacts by EOD Tue 7/21:

1) SCIM schema export (scim-schema-v2.csv) — includes core User attributes and Group support. Note: groups are supported via the "members" array and we include group.displayName and group.members[].value in the mapping.
2) RBAC matrix (rbac-matrix.csv) — columns: role, permission, default_assignable (true/false), examples. This will highlight the separation between admin/system roles and product roles.
3) SAML metadata (saml-metadata.xml) and a redacted sample SAML Response showing the attribute map we emit (email, firstName, lastName, groups).
4) Screenshots of the Admin console role assignment UI (admin-roles-screenshots.pdf) and a short note about the approval workflow (requests go through the Admin Approval queue; approvals are logged).

Notes/clarifications:
- SCIM provisioning enforces required attributes (email, externalId) on create; missing required attributes cause reject and are visible in the provisioning logs.
- We do not provision service account keys via SCIM — service accounts are created in the Admin console and keys are rotated automatically every 90 days per policy. I'll include the policy link in the Drive folder.

I'll open SEC-1123 for the evidence collection so we have an auditable trail (link included). Monica has agreed to sign the attestation once Rishi prepares the statement.

Laura
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <security@medixcorp.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 08:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: identity-controls evidence for SIG/CAIQ review

Elena — attaching the requested artifacts and a short readme that explains each file. All artifacts are in the secure Drive folder below; I also attached the most relevant files for convenience.

Delivered artifacts (attached / in Drive):
- saml-metadata.xml (SAML metadata for Redwood's IdP integration)
- sample-saml-response-redacted.xml (redacted attributes)
- scim-schema.csv (SCIM v2 export showing supported attributes and group mapping)
- provisioning-sample.log (sanitized snippet showing create/update/deprovision events)
- rbac-matrix.csv (role -> permission mapping; default admin roles flagged)
- admin-roles-screenshots.pdf (console screenshots of role assignment UI)
- least_privilege_attestation.pdf (signed by Monica Patel, Security Manager)

A few operational notes:
- SCIM group sync is supported for standard group objects and uses membership by value. We reject provisioning requests missing required attributes (email or externalId).
- Service accounts are managed via the Admin console and API keys are rotated every 90 days; on request we can provide a policy export (we included the policy link in the Drive bundle).
- Logs in provisioning-sample.log are redacted to remove PII; full logs can be shared under NDA if needed.

Secure Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cEXAMPLEsecureEvidence
HubSpot ticket: https://hubspot.app/deal/MDX-3892
Jira: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/SEC-1123

If you need anything else (e.g., live walkthrough or additional timestamps for the logs), we're happy to set up a short call.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Security Engineer — Redwood Inference
